text:
Residents:
Tomas works from home weekdays 09:00-17:30, usually in the office. Weekends he sleeps in, does errands midday (observed 11:00-12:00), and stays home otherwise. Hobbies: gym, jigsaw puzzles.
Ines is retired. Weekdays she is home most of the day, taking a morning walk (observed 08:00-09:00) and doing afternoon errands. Weekends she is home most of the day with a late-morning walk (observed 07:00-08:00) and a mid-afternoon gym trip (observed 15:00-16:00). She looks after the dog.

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their initial walkthrough locations unless noted.

Kitchen/Dining Cycle:
- 08:00-09:00: Breakfast. Bowls, mugs, vitamins, dog food bag move to kitchen table/sink.
- 10:00-11:00: Weekend breakfast. Bowls, mugs, vitamins move to kitchen table.
- 11:00: Cleanup. Dishes to cupboard/sink/dish rack. Knife/spatula to drawer.
- 19:00: Cooking prep. Knife, pan, pot, recipe book, spatula moved to counter.
- 20:00: Dinner setup. Plates, serving dish, glasses, water bottles moved to dining table. Recipe book to pantry.
- 21:00: Cleanup. Most dishes moved to cupboard/sink/dish rack. Knife to sink. Spatula to drawer.
- 23:00: Late night. Mug_ines and snack_bowl moved to sink.

Living Room:
- 20:00: Blanket moved bed to coffee table. Remote and snack bowl moved to coffee table.
- 21:00: Mug_ines, remote, snack bowl moved to coffee table.
- 23:00: Blanket moved coffee table to couch.

Entry/Personal Items:
- 07:00: Ines leaves for walk. Leash, hats, jackets, keys, shoes, sunglasses, wallets, headphones, water bottle removed from house.
- 08:00: Ines returns. All items returned to entry spots.
- 11:00: Tomas leaves (errands). Items removed.
- 12:00: Tomas returns. Items returned to entry spots.
- 15:00: Ines leaves (gym). Gym bag, headphones, jacket, keys, shoes, sunglasses, umbrella, wallet, water bottle removed.
- 16:00: Ines returns. Items returned to entry spots.

Office/Bedroom:
- 09:00-17:00: Tomas at desk. Laptop, mouse, pen, notebook, charger, water bottle, mug move between desk, floor, chair, and sink/counter.
- 16:00: Weekend work. Laptop, charger, mug, water bottle moved to desk.
- 17:00: Tomas leaves. Charger to nightstand. Mug to sink.
- 22:00: Book_tomas moved to bed.
- 23:00: Charger and glass_tomas to nightstand.

Static Items:
- Balcony: Gardening gloves, watering can.
- Bathroom: Detergent, hair dryer, laundry basket, toiletry bag, soap, toothbrushes, towels.
- Bedroom: Book, gym bags (Ines’s bag moves to wardrobe when she leaves).
- Dining: Vase.
- Kitchen: Kettle, plant pots, vitamins, wall clock, dog bowl, dog food.
- Living: Cushions, board game, picture frame, speaker, coasters, lamp, plant pot.
- Office: Plant pot.
- Storage: Ironing board, vacuum, toolbox.
